'''Usser''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] who served as a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Army|army]] during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the war, he was stationed on the neutral [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]] within [[Camp Talanis]] in the [[Gormak Lands]]. There, he encountered several of the native [[Voss (species)|Voss]] who were sympathetic to the Republic cause and volunteered to investigate a downed Republic [[Walker/Legends|walker]] near the camp. When they did not return, Usser became worried and sent a Republic aligned individual to check what had happened. The individual discovered that [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] [[Ssorokk|cyberbeasts]] had [[Death/Legends|killed]] the volunteers, and after slaying the beasts, returned to give Usser the bad news.
